column3: All analytic linear families and every Borel set require a dimension lower bound at almost every parameter. Subspace rank control does not supply an energy estimate for arbitrary fractals; integer-rank examples do not resolve interpolation. No full-scope route.

Uniform over arbitrary complex matrices, all p>1 and m>=2. Scalar/rank-one lower witnesses do not prove the noncommutative upper bound; p=2 is only an instance. No uniform sharp mechanism survives statement screening.

For every n>=6 both optimal density and uniqueness of extremizers are required. An n=6 family enumeration would not establish all-n classification; no compression/stability mechanism supplied. No enumeration executed.

All n,m>=2 compare worst-case circular transposition defects. A product construction would need a uniform bound on every circular permutation at size nm, not just a convenient product permutation. No such bridge; finite values insufficient.

Literal statement explicitly reports full Kwan-Sah-Sawhney-Simkin resolution for each fixed girth and sufficiently large admissible order. No novelty inference from open metadata; primary proof body not read here. Do not invest in rediscovery.

Literal statement explicitly says this all-slice multirank classification is proved in the cited paper. Isomorphism of linearizations is not isomorphism of persistence sets. Primary proof body unread; no proposed discovery.

Primary v1 Conjecture14 and v2 matching passage read. Exact own-score-maximizing recurrence with opponent-score min/max tie-break read. Full iff includes absence at every heap in integer-ratio case and first-discrepancy minimality otherwise. Two-action monotonicity theorem does not settle three-action recurrence; no all-heap period/invariant route. Follow-up [28] body unread; no game sweep invested.

Every CK decomposition and every m>=2 require a Chow-correspondence defect bound, not a cohomological degree bound. Dimension vanishing alone does not clear homologically trivial components. Definitions/primary body unread; no finite certificate route.

Universal five-label majority neighbor-sum bound at minimum degree2 simultaneously imposes local majority and unequal neighboring sums. Existing 12/15 bounds do not specialize to5; small graph feasibility would not yield universal construction. Definition body unread.

Polynomial-time algorithm required uniformly in graph and k under every edge degree-sum constraint. Existence or a fixed-density k regime is insufficient. No algorithm with termination and polynomial complexity proof; no instance count as outcome.

For all r>=2, matching size k below tau/(r-1) must imply connected matching reconfiguration graph. Need exact adjacency definition and full uniformity mechanism beyond r=3. No route from cover inequality to an admissible exchange sequence established.

Every tree order m and every connectivity k require preservation after deleting its embedding at the sharp linear degree threshold. Greedy embedding alone cannot protect residual k-connectivity. Known paths/k<=3 are parameter cases; no full route.

Minimal k-factor-critical graphs must attain minimum degree k+1 over all admissible orders and k. Planar/claw-free results do not cover arbitrary graphs. k=0 or empty boundary conventions are wording checks, not eligible outcomes; no structural minimality argument.
Statement reports 1987 Tait resolution, including prime-link nonalternating minimality clause. No knot invariant proof body read here. Known-result/formalization work earns no new outcome.

All admissible n congruent1 mod4 except9 require exact edge decompositions into Hamilton-cycle squares. Finite constructions and small n degeneracies cannot deliver uniform arithmetic construction. No all-order starter/difference mechanism available.

Each dimension d>=3 and every sufficiently large n require exact floor formula. A finite counterexample cannot defeat a dimension-dependent eventual threshold. Long induced-path constructions and convention on dimension need primary verification; no full route.

Every fixed positive n requires infinitely many recursively defined fractional-order primes or lucky numbers. n=1 already reaches lucky-prime infinitude; a finite sieve is irrelevant. Restricted factorization definitions not recovered; no infinitude mechanism.

Every rationally connected projective manifold with arbitrary open-Riemann-surface approximation and jet interpolation data is required. Rational curves through point pairs do not supply all Oka-1 approximation data. Large geometric dependency chain; no bounded constructive proof route.

v1/v2 Conjecture4.2 read: all k>=3 and k>d. Clique gives upper ratio; partitioning a degeneracy ordering into classes of capacity d+1 only gives the sharp ratio when divisibility cooperates. No all-parameter lower bound or counterexample; no parameter-only proposal.

Actual v1 and v2 Conjecture4.5 have the unrestricted graph/girth quantifiers. Executed 24-vertex cubic girth7 certificate: 36 edges, removing s vertices leaves at least36-3s edges, so any nonempty induced forest requires36-3s<=23-s and s>=7. Thus alpha1<=17<132/7=24-36/7. Elementary cycle-rank/degree counting on a standard cubic graph; treated as uncredited classical adaptation, not discovery-cleared. No exact maximum, minimality or registry clearance claimed.

All odd wheels including t=1 require ultimate Cartesian-power independence ratio1/4. Finite powers only bound a limiting parameter and chromatic lower bound supplies one direction. No tensor-power upper certificate or full uniform argument.

Displayed equation and following claimed value are inconsistent as written: alpha(W_(2t+1))=t makes displayed RHS solve to2t^2+t+1, not4t^2+5t+3. Product-vs-square/notation recovery from primary required. Wording correction is uncredited; no literal formula counterexample promoted.

All k require no uniqueness set of size<=k in a positive function class. Dimension heuristics do not prove existence of a positive function vanishing on arbitrary constraints; need exact class and positivity definitions. No primary definitions/body clearance.

Equivalence for arbitrary homomorphisms between finite-rank free groups requires torsion to be defined in the claimed scope, then detect surjectivity as well as injectivity. Equal-rank injective L2-homology result does not give arbitrary-map statement. Domain correction not credit; no route.

Every arbitrary orientation of a k-edge path under minimum semidegree>k/2. Directed/two-block paths are special cases; greedy path growth does not handle alternating obstructions uniformly. No all-orientation embedding mechanism.

For every compact action satisfying openness of each nonamenable subgroup image, require infinitesimal containment. Open-image information does not directly construct sparse factors/finite-model approximations. Amenable special case not a full proof; primary definitions unread.

Conditional on actual attainment, every Lambda-alpha maximizer must have Schwarzian norm6. Nonexistence or one extremal Koebe-type map would not prove universal conditional. Functional and E2 topology definitions missing from literal row; primary HOLD.

Every hereditary hypergraph family with finite2-color threshold must have each finite k-color threshold. Repeated2-color splitting fails without control that each color class remains heavy; no hereditary restriction lemma supplying that control. Known threshold2 case insufficient.

Every adelic measure over each number field needs one positive epsilon across all algebraic points strictly above the energy minimum. Standard height-gap/Lehmer tools do not transfer to arbitrary adelic energies. Literal row already reports failure evidence; actual measure/counterexample body unread. No numerical-height proposal.

Global minimization over all four dichotomic qubit measurements. Attaining2/sqrt13 supplies one inequality only; need universal incompatibility bound and exact unbiased/biased reduction. No global algebraic dual certificate; numerical optimization not executed.

Each fixed k>=2 needs c(k) logDelta lists for every sufficiently largeDelta multipartite hypergraph. Contains the bipartite graph case k2, so special higher-uniformity bounds do not settle it. No entropy/list-coloring mechanism at logarithmic scale.

All m-packed words of arbitrary multiplicity and all powers k>=m require equality of plactic centralizers. Bounded length or m3/4 computations cannot prove full stabilization; no tableau structural classification supplied. No word sweep executed.

Universal divisibility over equiconstructible real side lengths needs normalized integer tile hypotheses from primary. Rescaling arbitrary tile lengths destroys naive integer divisibility; such a domain correction earns no credit. Square-free lemma does not settle5,16,19; no coloring invariant.

Literal statement explicitly credits Elliott with the eventual-time average asymptotic. Strict barrier definition and epsilon domain require source precision but do not create a new outcome. Actual Elliott body not read here.

Although marked full, literal record omits the actual upper-bound formula and theorem number, and contains damaged n>=1 text. Cannot assess universal equality against an unspecified quantity. Primary formula recovery needed; metadata not technical clearance.

All fixed uniformities k require a linear-in-edge bound for set mappings avoiding their own edges. Randomly embedding G gives dependency terms involving high vertex degrees; graph proof does not automatically extend. No hypergraph deletion/embedding argument eliminating this obstruction.

All k,q,t1,t2 require both all-symbol PIR and batch subadditivity. Concatenating generator blocks serves message symbols but must recover each new parity symbol too; general all-symbol property is the missing bridge. No full construction; classical functional-code subadditivity is insufficient.

All m and admissible t require sharp forbidden-configuration count and equality at every multiple of t. Kt block construction proves lower witness only. No induction controlling arbitrary simple matrices at exact slope; t boundary/domain recovery required.

Universal d0,c and every n-vertex connected minimum-degree-d graph require polynomial anticoncentration for each tree isomorphism class. Labeled-tree counts do not control concentration on one unlabeled shape; high-degree hubs defeat almost-regular reductions. No switching argument uniform in irregularity.

For every graph the sum of its top two eigenvalues must be<=8n/7. Trace/norm estimates only yield weaker bounds; tree result is not arbitrary graph control. No rational quotient-matrix witness or global spectral inequality found; no numerical spectral sweep.

All epsilon in[0,1] need strict monotone thresholds at both low and high p with exact index2 for every qualifying graph. Endpoint/infinity wording alone would be uncredited; no flow-vector construction with simultaneous norm control. Primary definitions needed.

Every integrable scalar hierarchy in the specified normal form needs all odd coefficients zero, unique determination of mixed even coefficients and free choice of every even one. Finite perturbation-order checks cannot establish arbitrary-order integrability or existence. No generating-function recursion proving all obligations.

All connected min-degree3 graphs and arbitrary degree+1 lists need proper coloring with a unique-colored neighbor at every vertex. Greedy proper coloring consumes available slack and does not enforce neighbor uniqueness. Sparse graph results not full scope; no reducible-configuration closure.

Literal statement explicitly reports Baber/Borg counterexamples for every k>=5. The assertion is already refuted as a universal tree claim. Original counterexample bodies unread here; do not search a smaller witness for credit.

Each Hadwiger bound k needs nonisomorphic graphs indistinguishable by all bounded-Hadwiger test graphs. Constructing equal counts on a finite set of tests is insufficient. Vortex-free-class theorem does not cover arbitrary excluded-minor classes; no full construction.

Generalizing the three-vertex gain needs a new local structural lemma when every closed neighborhood meets residual fort in at most3 vertices. Published grid example defeats stronger gain>=fortsize but only gives gain6, so does not refute gain4. No small certificate or full lemma established; no graph sweep.

For every fixed d>=3 need induced matching density tending to zero uniformly through finite fields. Fixed q or one coordinate slice gives no asymptotic upper bound in full dimension. No removal/finite-field incidence theorem bridge; no enumeration.

Requires one absolute positive power saving over exponent3/2 for all large prime fields. Excluding square-field Hermitian examples is not an upper bound; qualitative o(q^1.5) alone insufficient. No sum-product/incidence mechanism with required uniform exponent.
